convection.name: Convection
convection.description: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

energizer.name: Energizer
energizer.description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

hellwrought.name: Hellwrought
hellwrought.description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

quagmire.name: Quagmire
quagmire.description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

battenDownTheHatches.name: Batten Down the Hatches
battenDownTheHatches.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

torment.name: Torment
torment.description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

recoil.name: Recoil
recoil.description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

bombshell.name: Bombshell
bombshell.description: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

mobility.name: Mobility
mobility.description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

vision.name: Vision
vision.description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

darkSeduction.name: Dark Seduction
darkSeduction.description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

flashingBlade.name: Flashing Blade
flashingBlade.description: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon’s melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.description: Enemy spells that target an affected friendly model/unit suffer –5 RNG.

morrowsBlessing.name: Morrow’s Blessing
morrowsBlessing.description: Target friendly model/unit’s weapons gain Damage Type: Magical.

crusaderSCall.name: Crusader's Call
crusaderSCall.description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain +2 SPD. Crusader’s Call lasts for one turn.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit can reroll its missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortune.

repudiate.name: Repudiate
repudiate.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Repudiate immediately expire. When an upkeep spell expires as a result of Repudiate, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.description: Sunburst blast damage affects only enemy models. Models boxed by Sunburst are removed from play.

arcantrikBolt.name: Arcantrik Bolt
arcantrikBolt.description: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks.

deathWard.name: Death Ward
deathWard.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. If an affected warjack is damaged, choose which column suffers the damage.

ironAggression.name: Iron Aggression
ironAggression.description: Target friendly Faction warjack can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

scourge.name: Scourge
scourge.description: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack become knocked down.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

bulletDodger.name: Bullet Dodger
bulletDodger.description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

calamity.name: Calamity
calamity.description: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM.

escort.name: Escort
escort.description: Cohort models in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. The spellcaster gains +2 ARM while one or more cohort models in its battlegroup are within 3" of it.

obliteration.name: Obliteration
obliteration.description: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

cyclone.name: Cyclone
cyclone.description: The spellcaster immediately makes a full advance. At the end of this movement, the spellcaster can make one basic melee attack against each model in its LOS that is in its melee range. Cyclone can be cast only once per activation.

razorWind.name: Razor Wind
razorWind.description: On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

wintersWrath.name: Winter’s Wrath
wintersWrath.description: Winter’s Wrath causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit becomes stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

snowShroud.name: Snow Shroud
snowShroud.description: Friendly Faction models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range. Snow Shroud lasts for one round.

boundlessCharge.name: Boundless Charge
boundlessCharge.description: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

fogOfWar.name: Fog of War
fogOfWar.description: Models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range.

ironFlesh.name: Iron Flesh
ironFlesh.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

redline.name: Redline
redline.description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

windRush.name: Wind Rush
windRush.description: The spellcaster can immediately make a full advance and gains +2 DEF for one round. Wind Rush can be cast only once per activation.

openFire.name: Open Fire
openFire.description: Target Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Open Fire only once per turn.

avengingForce.name: Avenging Force
avengingForce.description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in the spellcaster's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

deflection.name: Deflection
deflection.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks. Deflection lasts for one round.

dash.name: Dash
dash.description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models activating in its control range gain +1 SPD. Dash lasts for one turn.

onslaught.name: Onslaught
onslaught.description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Relentless Charge for one turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

returnFire.name: Return Fire
returnFire.description: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

handOfDestruction.name: Hand of Destruction
handOfDestruction.description: Friendly models in this model’s battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

assail.name: Assail
assail.description: Target friendly Faction warjack can charge or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. The warjack gains +2 SPD when it charges or makes a slam or trample power attack. Models slammed by the warjack are moved +2".

fullThrottle.name: Full Throttle
fullThrottle.description: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus that activation. While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted melee attack rolls. Full Throttle lasts for one turn.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.description: Target friendly Faction model gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

deceleration.name: Deceleration
deceleration.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.description: This attack causes fire damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Fire entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffer the Fire continuous effect.

groundZero.name: Ground Zero
groundZero.description: Other models within 3" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 blast damage roll. Immediately after this damage is resolved each enemy model damaged by Ground Zero is pushed d6" directly away from the spellcaster in the order you choose.

jumpstart.name: Jumpstart
jumpstart.description: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

roadToWar.name: Road to War
roadToWar.description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

airburst.name: Airburst
airburst.description: Target any model in the spellcaster’s control range, ignoring LOS. When resolving Airburst, ignore cover, concealment, and Stealth.

battleLust.name: Battle Lust
battleLust.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains an additional die on melee damage rolls but suffers –2 DEF.

grind.name: Grind
grind.description: When a warjack is hit by Grind, it suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement system box.

inhospitableGround.name: Inhospitable Ground
inhospitableGround.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain. Inhospitable Ground lasts for one round.

superiority.name: Superiority
superiority.description: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 SPD, MAT, and DEF and cannot become knocked down.

guidedFire.name: Guided Fire
guidedFire.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls for one turn.

lightningStrike.name: Lightning Strike
lightningStrike.description: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

forceAura.name: Force Aura
forceAura.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.description: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.description: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down or stationary and does not suffer collateral damage. When it is slammed, reduce the slam distance rolled by 3. Safeguard lasts for one round.

farStrike.name: Far Strike
farStrike.description: The spellcaster’s ranged weapons gain Snipe. (An attack with a weapon with Snipe gains +3 RNG.)

prescience.name: Prescience
prescience.description: Target friendly Faction model gains Future Sight. Prescience lasts for one turn.

sandStorm.name: Sand Storm
sandStorm.description: When a friendly model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 5" of this model, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Sand Storm lasts for one round.

burningAsh.name: Burning Ash
burningAsh.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

inviolableResolve.name: Inviolable Resolve
inviolableResolve.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

killingGround.name: Killing Ground
killingGround.description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain Pathfinder. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can charge or make slam power attacks against enemy models without being forced. Killing Ground lasts for one turn.

counterblast.name: Counterblast
counterblast.description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

fateWalker.name: Fate Walker
fateWalker.description: The spellcaster gains Reposition [5"] this activation. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

artificeOfDeviation.name: Artifice of Deviation
artificeOfDeviation.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain cover. Enemy models treat the template as rough terrain.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.description: Target friendly Faction model gains an additional die on its next ranged attack roll this turn.

scavengersBlessing.name: Scavenger’s Blessing
scavengersBlessing.description: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

warpath.name: Warpath
warpath.description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A Cohort model can advance as a result of Warpath only once per turn.

spinyGrowth.name: Spiny Growth
spinyGrowth.description: The spellcaster gains +2 ARM. If a non-warrior model hits the spellcaster with a melee attack, the attacking model suffers d3 damage points immediately after the attack is resolved unless the spellcaster was destroyed or removed from play by the attack. Spiny Growth lasts for one round.

forceStrike.name: Force Strike
forceStrike.description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

stormRager.name: Storm Rager
stormRager.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model gains +2 MAT and ARM and +2 on melee attack damage rolls and cannot be targeted by combined ranged attacks or combined melee attacks.

irresistibleForce.name: Irresistible Force
irresistibleForce.description: The spellcaster gains Bulldoze. Irresistible Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

rush.name: Rush
rush.description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and gains Pathfinder. Rush lasts for one turn.

ornery.name: Ornery
ornery.description: The spellcaster gains Retaliatory Strike. Ornery lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

firstBlood.name: First Blood
firstBlood.description: When an enemy model is damaged by First Blood, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can make a full advance toward the damaged model. A model can advance as a result of First Blood only once per turn.

synergy.name: Synergy
synergy.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

rapport.name: Rapport
rapport.description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can use the spellcaster’s current MAT and RAT in place of its own. When checking to see if the affected Cohort model is in its controller’s control range, double the range.

stranglehold.name: Stranglehold
stranglehold.description: A model damaged by Stranglehold forfeits either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

deathbringers.name: Deathbringers
deathbringers.description: While within the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Grievous Wounds. Deathbringers lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

manifestDestiny.name: Manifest Destiny
manifestDestiny.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Manifest Destiny lasts for one turn.

scythingTouch.name: Scything Touch
scythingTouch.description: Target friendly Faction model gains Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer – 2 ARM.)

whiteSquall.name: White Squall
whiteSquall.description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by White Squall is thrown d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this throw is POW 12.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.description: When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

carnage.name: Carnage
carnage.description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

curseOfShadows.name: Curse of Shadows
curseOfShadows.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

huntersMark.name: Hunter’s Mark
huntersMark.description: Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

roughSeas.name: Rough Seas
roughSeas.description: When a friendly model in the spellcaster’s control range is targeted with a ranged attack, the attacking model rolls an additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll. Rough Seas lasts for one round.

backlash.name: Backlash
backlash.description: When target enemy warjack that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

bloodRain.name: Blood Rain
bloodRain.description: Blood Rain causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

darkGuidance.name: Dark Guidance
darkGuidance.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee attack rolls this turn.

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.description: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

ritualSacrifice.name: Ritual Sacrifice
ritualSacrifice.description:
Remove target friendly warrior model from play. Skarre gains d6 additional focus points at the start of her next activation. Skarre
can gain the benefit of Ritual Sacrifice only once per round.

darkWaves.name: Dark Waves
darkWaves.description: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement this activation, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Dark Waves expires. A model can be placed as a result of Dark Waves only once per turn.

wellOfHate.name: Well of Hate
wellOfHate.description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain Murderous while in its control range. Well of Hate lasts for one turn. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 to its melee damage rolls.

whisperingVeil.name: Whispering Veil
whisperingVeil.description: The spellcaster gains Telemetry. Whispering Veil lasts for one turn. (Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of a model with Telemetry.)

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: The spellcaster gains concealment. Living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of the spellcaster. Swarm lasts for one round.

submerge.name: Submerge
submerge.description: The spellcaster cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks and does not block LOS. Submerge lasts for one round.

elasticity.name: Elasticity
elasticity.description: Target friendly Faction model’s melee weapons become RNG 2. Elasticity lasts for one turn.

floodwaters.name: Floodwaters
floodwaters.description: While within 5" of the spellcaster, models treat open terrain as shallow water.

blackestNight.name: Blackest Night
blackestNight.description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –1 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

carnivore.name: Carnivore
carnivore.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack rolls. When an affected model destroys a living or undead model with a melee attack, the destroyed model is removed from play and the spellcaster can remove d3 damage points.

deathRattle.name: Death Rattle
deathRattle.description: When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.

hexBlast.name: Hex Blast
hexBlast.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

occultation.name: Occultation
occultation.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

parasite.name: Parasite
parasite.description: Target model/unit suffers -3 ARM and the spellcaster gains +1 ARM.

deadweight.name: Deadweight
deadweight.description: When Deadweight destroys an enemy living or undead model, choose an enemy model within 2" of it. The chosen model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

ghostWalk.name: Ghost Walk
ghostWalk.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

graveWind.name: Grave Wind
graveWind.description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

signsPortents.name: Signs & Portents
signsPortents.description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Signs & Portents lasts for one turn.

deathPact.name: Death Pact
deathPact.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and Undead. Death Pact lasts for one round.

mortality.name: Mortality
mortality.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM, loses Tough, and cannot have damage removed from it. Mortality lasts for one round.

soulVoid.name: Soul Void
soulVoid.description: When target friendly Faction model/unit destroys a living enemy model with a melee attack, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

venom.name: Venom
venom.description: Venom causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

causticMist.name: Caustic Mist
causticMist.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

wealdSecrets.name: Weald Secrets
wealdSecrets.description: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

influence.name: Influence
influence.description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

starCrossed.name: Star-Crossed
starCrossed.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll. Star-Crossed lasts for one round.

perdition.name: Perdition
perdition.description: When an enemy model is damaged by Perdition, immediately after the attack is resolved the spellcaster or one model in its battlegroup that is currently in its control range can advance up to 5" directly toward the nearest enemy model. A model can advance as a result of Perdition only once per turn.

wateryGrave.name: Watery Grave
wateryGrave.description: When a model is boxed by Watery Grave, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

tantrum.name: Tantrum
tantrum.description: If one or more models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup were damaged by enemy attacks while within 5" of the spellcaster during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.description: Target cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Berserk. While affected by Ravager, a model cannot make Chain Attacks. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.)

blackSpot.name: Black Spot
blackSpot.description: Target enemy warrior model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a friendly Faction model destroys one or more affected models with a basic melee or ranged attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one additional melee or ranged attack. Attacks gained from Black Spot cannot generate additional attacks from Black Spot.

shellfishBullets.name: Shellfish Bullets
shellfishBullets.description: The next enemy model to be hit by a ranged attack made by this model cannot secure Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches for one round.

highNoon.name: High Noon
highNoon.description: Target friendly Faction model / unit gain +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

gallows.name: Gallows
gallows.description: When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Gallows’ point of origin.

excessiveHealing.name: Excessive Healing
excessiveHealing.description: The spellcaster gains Rapid Healing for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

fortify.name: Fortify
fortify.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM. That model and any friendly models B2B with it cannot become knocked down, be pushed, or be moved by a slam.

furysStrength.name: Fury’s Strength
furysStrength.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

powderKeg.name: Powder Keg
powderKeg.description: On a critical hit, the model directly hit loses its initial attacks and cannot make power attacks or special attacks for one round.

ferociousImpact.name: Ferocious Impact
ferociousImpact.description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 to its next ranged attack damage roll.

crawlingChaos.name: Crawling Chaos
crawlingChaos.description: While B2B with the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance. Crawling Chaos lasts for one round.

crawlingChaos__4f82447e.name: Crawling Chaos
crawlingChaos__4f82447e.description: While B2B with the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance. Crawling Chaos lasts for one round.

scuttle.name: Scuttle
scuttle.description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter and Standing Tall. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".) (Friendly models can advance through a model with Standing Tall if they have enough movement to move completely past it.)

flamingFists.name: Flaming Fists
flamingFists.description: The spellcaster gains +2 to melee damage rolls and Resistance: Fire, and its melee weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire. Flaming Fists lasts for one round.

brandOfFire.name: Brand of Fire
brandOfFire.description: Brand of Fire causes fire damage. On a hit, the target model and the d3 nearest enemy models within 3" of it suffer the Fire continuous effect.

fireStep.name: Fire Step
fireStep.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll . After the damage is resolved, place the spellcaster completely within 2" of its current location. Fire Step can be cast only once per activation.

firestarter.name: Firestarter
firestarter.description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup. That model’s melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

tidesOfWar.name: Tides of War
tidesOfWar.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

huntingHowls.name: Hunting Howls
huntingHowls.description: Enemy models lose Stealth while within 5" of the spellcaster. Hunting Howls lasts for one turn.

earthSpikes.name: Earth Spikes
earthSpikes.description: When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

rapidGrowth.name: Rapid Growth
rapidGrowth.description: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is forest terrain that remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid.

solidGround.name: Solid Ground
solidGround.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or be pushed and gain Resistance: Blast.

stoneSkin.name: Stone Skin
stoneSkin.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 melee attack damage rolls and +2 ARM but suffers –1 SPD and DEF.

crevasse.name: Crevasse
crevasse.description: If Crevasse boxes its original target, you can make a SP 6 attack using the boxed model as the attack’s point of origin. Models hit suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. Models boxed by Crevasse are removed from play.

rockWall.name: Rock Wall
rockWall.description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

rootsOfTheEarth.name: Roots of the Earth
rootsOfTheEarth.description: Target friendly Faction model gains +3 ARM, cannot become knocked down, and cannot move or be placed. Roots of the Earth lasts for one round.

mysticWards.name: Mystic Wards
mysticWards.description: Enemy animi and enemy upkeep spells on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are in its control range immediately expire. Enemy arcane attacks targeting a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup suffer –5 RNG. Mystic Wards lasts for one round.

rift.name: Rift
rift.description: Center a 3" template on the model directly hit. The template is rough terrain and remains in play for one round.

earthsBlessing.name: Earth’s Blessing
earthsBlessing.description: The spellcaster cannot be pushed, knocked down, made stationary, or moved by a slam. Earth’s Blessing lasts for one round.

wraithbane.name: Wraithbane
wraithbane.description: Target friendly Faction model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Wraithbane lasts for one turn.

elusive.name: Elusive
elusive.description: The spellcaster gains Dodge. Elusive lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

arcaneProtections.name: Arcane Protections
arcaneProtections.description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models cannot channel spells. Arcane Protections lasts for one round.

primal.name: Primal
primal.description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 MAT and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round and automatically frenzies during your next Control Phase. The target warbeast frenzies even if Primal was removed by a spell, special rule, or casting of a new animus on it prior to your next Control Phase.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.description: If target enemy model/unit advances during its activation, one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make a full advance.

sureFoot.name: Sure Foot
sureFoot.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

abattoir.name: Abattoir
abattoir.description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic melee attack. Abattoir can be cast only once per turn.

dogPile.name: Dog Pile
dogPile.description: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without being forced. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

forcedEvolution.name: Forced Evolution
forcedEvolution.description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 DEF and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls

muzzle.name: Muzzle
muzzle.description: An enemy warbeast damaged by Muzzle cannot advance toward the spellcaster for one round.

shadowPack.name: Shadow Pack
shadowPack.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth. Shadow Pack lasts for one round.

spiritShift.name: Spirit Shift
spiritShift.description: When Laris casts Spirit Shift, immediately place him completely within 2" of Kaya. When Kaya casts Spirit Shift, immediately place her completely within 2" of Laris. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Spirit Shift.

soothingSong.name: Soothing Song
soothingSong.description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently in the spellcaster’s control range. Soothing Song can be cast only once per activation.

spiritDoor.name: Spirit Door
spiritDoor.description: Choose a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Immediately place that model completely within 2" of the spellcaster. If the chosen model is the spellcaster, immediately place it completely within 2" of another model in its battlegroup that was in its control range at the time the spell was cast. A model cannot advance or attack after being placed by Spirit Door this turn.

spiritFang.name: Spirit Fang
spiritFang.description: A model damaged by this attack suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

bloodSpiller.name: Blood Spiller
bloodSpiller.description: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Blood Spiller without being forced for one turn.

bestial.name: Bestial
bestial.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models cannot cast non-animus spells or be used to channel spells. Bestial lasts for one round.

wildAggression.name: Wild Aggression
wildAggression.description: Target friendly living warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

sunderSpirit.name: Sunder Spirit
sunderSpirit.description: An enemy warbeast damaged by Sunder Spirit loses its animus for one round.

lightningStorm.name: Lightning Storm
lightningStorm.description: On a direct hit, center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The cloud is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

windstorm.name: Windstorm
windstorm.description: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

fleetingStorm.name: Fleeting Storm
fleetingStorm.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. Ranged attacks targetting a model completely within the template suffer –3 RNG. The AOE remains in play for one round.

lightningTendrils.name: Lightning Tendrils
lightningTendrils.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Resistance: Electricity. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap.

spontaneousCombustion.name: Spontaneous Combustion
spontaneousCombustion.description: The spellcaster and models within 2" of it immediately suffer the Fire continuous effect.

arcaneSuppression.name: Arcane Suppression
arcaneSuppression.description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Arcane Suppression lasts for one round.

druidSWrath.name: Druid's Wrath
druidSWrath.description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on arcane attack rolls targeting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster. Druid’s Wrath lasts for one turn.

chainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
chainLightning.description: A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

skyborne.name: Skyborne
skyborne.description: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and DEF and Flight for one round.

undergrowth.name: Undergrowth
undergrowth.description: While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain and suffer –2 DEF. Undergrowth lasts for one round.

mirage.name: Mirage
mirage.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

pillarOfSalt.name: Pillar of Salt
pillarOfSalt.description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not overlap a model's base. The template is considered to be a friendly huge-based construct model. The template has DEF 5 and ARM 20, and is removed from play if it suffers 1 or more damage points. The template has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down, placed, or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks. The template remains in play for one round.

sandsOfFate.name: Sands of Fate
sandsOfFate.description: Remove a friendly living Faction trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with the spellcaster. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after being placed by Sands of Fate.

sunhammer.name: Sunhammer
sunhammer.description: Enemy warbeasts and warjacks that advance more than 1" and end their Normal Movement in the spellcaster’s control range suffer d3 damage points.

eruptionOfLife.name: Eruption of Life
eruptionOfLife.description: If this attack destroys a living or undead enemy model, center a 3" template on the destroyed model, then remove that model from play. The template is forest terrain that remains in play for one round. Enemy models in the template when it is put into play suffer an unboostable POW 13 blast damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.description: When a living or undead enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster’s control range, the spellcaster can gain 1 fury point. The spellcaster’s fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Harvest.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. During your Control Phase, the spellcaster can spend fury points to return one destroyed small- or medium-based living Grunt from that unit to play for each fury point spent. A returned Grunt must be placed in the spellcaster’s control range and within 2" of another model in its unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box and must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions this turn.

censure.name: Censure
censure.description: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

blackTalons.name: Black Talons
blackTalons.description: On a critical hit, models hit suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

amuck.name: Amuck
amuck.description: When target friendly Faction warbeast makes a power attack or special attack, its attack rolls are boosted. Amuck lasts for one turn.

skyFire.name: Sky Fire
skyFire.description: The spellcaster gains Ionization [10"] for one turn. (When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 10" of a model with Ionization, add +2 to the roll.)

admonition.name: Admonition
admonition.description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

affliction.name: Affliction
affliction.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point.

veilOfMists.name: Veil of Mists
veilOfMists.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template does not block friendly Faction models’ LOS. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder and can move through obstructions and other models if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.description: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

twister.name: Twister
twister.description: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template remains in play for one round.

windWall.name: Wind Wall
windWall.description: The spellcaster cannot make ranged attacks after casting this spell, and non-magical ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss. While within 3" of the spellcaster, models cannot make ranged attacks and non-magical ranged attacks targeting them automatically miss. Wind Wall lasts for one round.

dopplerBark.name: Doppler Bark
dopplerBark.description: Living or undead enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster have their base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

winterCoat.name: Winter Coat
winterCoat.description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Cold and Freezer. Winter Coat lasts for one round. (When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of a model with Freezer, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.)

darkPath.name: Dark Path
darkPath.description: Dark Path can be cast only while Cassius is in Wurmwood’s control range. Immediately place Cassius completely within 2" of Wurmwood or place Wurmwood completely within 2" of Cassius. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Dark Path.

hellmouth.name: Hellmouth
hellmouth.description: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

deathMarch.name: Death March
deathMarch.description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 MAT and Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.")

fleshEater.name: Flesh Eater
fleshEater.description: When a living enemy model is damaged by Flesh Eater, the spellcaster or a living warbeast in its battlegroup and in its control range can remove d3 damage points.

tidePool.name: Tide Pool
tidePool.description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.description: Frostbite causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

stonehold.name: Stonehold
stonehold.description: Enemy models roll one less die on attack damage rolls against the spellcaster. The spellcaster and friendly Faction models B2B with it cannot become knocked down.

bearHands.name: Bear Hands
bearHands.description: When the spellcaster hits an enemy model with a basic melee attack, it can choose to knock down the enemy model or push it 3" directly away. Bear Hands lasts for one turn.

hauntingMelody.name: Haunting Melody
hauntingMelody.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, living enemy models cannot make melee or ranged attacks targeting a model in spellcaster's battlegroup.

aggravator.name: Aggravator
aggravator.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

cripplingGrasp.name: Crippling Grasp
cripplingGrasp.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, an affected model suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

psychoSurgery.name: Psycho Surgery
psychoSurgery.description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

batteringRam.name: Battering Ram
batteringRam.description: An enemy model hit by Battering Ram can be pushed 3" directly away from the spell’s point of origin.

engineOfDestruction.name: Engine of Destruction
engineOfDestruction.description: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

primed.name: Primed
primed.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, models within 1" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll and the affected model is removed from play.

distraction.name: Distraction
distraction.description: Target warrior model/unit cannot make ranged attacks and suffers –2 DEF and MAT for one round.

veilOfDarkness.name: Veil of Darkness
veilOfDarkness.description: When target friendly Faction model/unit is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –5 RNG.

bondOfGristleBone.name: Bond of Gristle & Bone
bondOfGristleBone.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM and Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or magic attacks while knocked down.)

pigpen.name: Pigpen
pigpen.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain.

pigFarm.name: Pig Farm
pigFarm.description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee damage rolls against living models and Snacking. Pig Farm lasts for one turn. (When a model with Snacking boxes a living model with a melee attack, the model with Snacking can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.)

luckyShot.name: Lucky Shot
luckyShot.description: Target friendly Faction model can reroll its next missed ranged attack roll this turn. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Lucky Shot. Lucky shot lasts for one turn.

slaughterhouse.name: Slaughterhouse
slaughterhouse.description: The spellcaster’s melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Slaughterhouse lasts for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

polarityShield.name: Polarity Shield
polarityShield.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

arcanePropulsion.name: Arcane Propulsion
arcanePropulsion.description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

bladedGale.name: Bladed Gale
bladedGale.description: Models hit lose Flight for one round.

razorWall.name: Razor Wall
razorWall.description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. An enemy model entering or ending its activation within 1" of the wall suffers a POW 10 damage roll. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

unstoppableForce.name: Unstoppable Force
unstoppableForce.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Bulldoze. Unstoppable Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

forcedInduction.name: Forced Induction
forcedInduction.description: Target enemy warjack gains 1 focus point. Then the warjack and enemy models within 1" for each focus point on it suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll.

mageSight.name: Mage Sight
mageSight.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Eyeless Sight.

magicBullet.name: Magic Bullet
magicBullet.description: If target friendly Faction model’s next basic ranged attack directly hits, after resolving the attack choose another model within 4" of the model hit. The chosen model suffers an unboostable POW 12 magical damage roll. The point of origin for this damage is the model hit. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After resolving this damage roll, Magic Bullet expires. Magic Bullet lasts for one turn.

spellpiercer.name: Spellpiercer
spellpiercer.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of friendly Faction models gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Spellpiercer lasts for one turn.

discontinuity.name: Discontinuity
discontinuity.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Dispel. (When a weapon with Dispel hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.)

dissolutionBolt.name: Dissolution Bolt
dissolutionBolt.description: A model hit by Dissolution Bolt cannot channel spells for one round.

positiveCharge.name: Positive Charge
positiveCharge.description: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. While within 3" of the affected Cohort model, other friendly Faction models gain +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Positive Charge lasts for one turn.

hotShot__eb5f08e0.name: Hot-Shot
hotShot__eb5f08e0.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

magneticHold.name: Magnetic Hold
magneticHold.description: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction construct models charging an affected model gain +2 SPD.

domination.name: Domination
domination.description: Take control of target enemy warjack that has a non-crippled cortex. You can make a full advance with the warjack and can then make one basic attack, then Domination expires. Domination can be cast only once per activation. A warjack can be affected by Domination only once per turn.

fireGroup.name: Fire Group
fireGroup.description: While models in the spellcaster's battlegroup are in its control range, their ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Fire Group lasts for one turn.

shrapnelSwarm.name: Shrapnel Swarm
shrapnelSwarm.description: On a direct hit, after resolving the damage roll, the model hit and models within 1" suffer 1 damage point.

tacticalSupremacy.name: Tactical Supremacy
tacticalSupremacy.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

forcedInduction__0c8be4b9.name: Forced Induction
forcedInduction__0c8be4b9.description: On a direct hit, target enemy Cohort gains 1 focus, fury or essence point. Then the target Cohort model and each enemy model within 1" for each focus, fury or essence point on it suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll.

secondSight.name: Second Sight
secondSight.description: Target friendly model gains Eyeless Sight.

hotShot.name: Hot-Shot
hotShot.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

feedbackLoop.name: Feedback Loop
feedbackLoop.description: When target enemy Cohort model that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, Resistance: Electricity, and Repulsor Field. (When a model model with Repulsor Field is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from that model.)

locomotion.name: Locomotion
locomotion.description: The spellcaster spends up to 3 focus points to cast Locomotion. Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup immediately advances up to 1" for each focus point spent. A Cohort model can be targeted by Locomotion only once per activation.

aerogenesis.name: Aerogenesis
aerogenesis.description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models/units beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and Flight during their activations. Aerogenesis lasts for one turn.

arcaneMight.name: Arcane Might
arcaneMight.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models can spend 1 focus or fury point on the spellcaster to boost a melee attack or melee damage roll during their activations.

jackhammer.name: Jackhammer
jackhammer.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.description: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

purification.name: Purification
purification.description: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire.

stygianAbyss.name: Stygian Abyss
stygianAbyss.description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

disintegration.name: Disintegration
disintegration.description: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

forceHammer.name: Force Hammer
forceHammer.description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

failSafe.name: Fail-Safe
failSafe.description: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

arcanePropulsion__ce4140bd.name: Arcane Propulsion
arcanePropulsion__ce4140bd.description: Target cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

firepower.name: Firepower
firepower.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.

instabilityEquation.name: Instability Equation
instabilityEquation.description: Target friendly warjack stands up and is no longer stationary. If the warjack was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains up to 3 focus points and gains Unstable for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which a model with Unstable spent more than 1 focus point, roll a d6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of focus points spent, the model with Unstable explodes and other models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll. Remove the model with Unstable from play.)

bloodOfLiberty.name: Blood of Liberty
bloodOfLiberty.description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Llaelese models gain Tough and +2 ARM.

chosenGround.name: Chosen Ground
chosenGround.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Pathfinder and cannot become knocked down.

quicken.name: Quicken
quicken.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 SPD and DEF against ranged and magic attack rolls.

broadside.name: Broadside
broadside.description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. Broadside can be cast only once per activation.

countermeasure.name: Countermeasure
countermeasure.description: While within 5" of target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

strengthOfGranite.name: Strength of Granite
strengthOfGranite.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +4 to its melee attack damage rolls.

darkFire.name: Dark Fire
darkFire.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

dauntlessResolve.name: Dauntless Resolve
dauntlessResolve.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +3 ARM and Tough.

lifebound.name: Lifebound
lifebound.description: Target friendly living model/unit gains Shield Guard. When an affected model is destroyed by an enemy attack, the spellcaster gains its soul token. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

cloakOfAsh.name: Cloak of Ash
cloakOfAsh.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ashen Veil. (A model with Ashen Veil has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Ashen Veil.)

vanish__fdc84d11.name: Vanish
vanish__fdc84d11.description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

soulGate.name: Soul Gate
soulGate.description: Remove a friendly trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. The warjack cannot activate this turn after being placed by Soul Gate.

lamentation.name: Lamentation
lamentation.description: When an enemy model casts a spell while in the spellcaster’s control range, double the COST of the spell. Additionally, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells on models/units in the spellcaster’s control range.

shadowmancer.name: Shadowmancer
shadowmancer.description: While in spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth and Dark Shroud. Shadowmancer lasts for one round. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

abyssalGate.name: Abyssal Gate
abyssalGate.description: When Abyssal Gate damages a non-Leader enemy model, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Abyssal Gate only once per turn.

infernalMachine.name: Infernal Machine
infernalMachine.description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Murderous and +2 SPD. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

siphonBolt.name: Siphon Bolt
siphonBolt.description: When this spell hits an enemy model with 1 or more focus or fury points on it, that model loses 1 focus or fury point and the spellcaster gains 1 focus point. Spellcasters without the Focus Manipulation special rule cannot gain focus as a result of Siphon Bolt.

breathOfCorruption.name: Breath of Corruption
breathOfCorruption.description: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

annihilation.name: Annihilation
annihilation.description: Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

excarnate.name: Excarnate
excarnate.description: When a living enemy warrior model is boxed by Excarnate, remove it from play. You can then add one Grunt to a friendly Faction small-based undead unit in the spellcaster’s control range. Place the Grunt within 1" of another model in the unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

hellbound.name: Hellbound
hellbound.description: The spellcaster cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open ground as rough terrain. Hellbound lasts for one round.

malediction.name: Malediction
malediction.description: While within 2" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM.

feastOfWorms.name: Feast of Worms
feastOfWorms.description: Center a cloud template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM. When a living enemy model is destroyed in the template, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

doomSpiral.name: Doom Spiral
doomSpiral.description: When Doom Spiral damages a warjack that is part of a battlegroup, its controller suffers d3 damage points.

overrun.name: Overrun
overrun.description: When target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with an attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved one other model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can make a full advance, then Overrun expires. A model can advance only once per turn as a result of Overrun. Overrun lasts for one turn.

sacrificialLamb.name: Sacrificial Lamb
sacrificialLamb.description: Remove one friendly Faction warrior model in the spellcaster’s control range from play. Each warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range gains 1 focus point. Sacrificial Lamb can be cast only once per activation.

spectralSteel.name: Spectral Steel
spectralSteel.description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Ghostly. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

goad.name: Goad
goad.description: Target Cohort model in this model's battlegroup immediately gains 1 focus point.

breathStealer.name: Breath Stealer
breathStealer.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

damnation.name: Damnation
damnation.description: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without spending focus. They can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. They gain +2" movement and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

shadowStep.name: Shadow Step
shadowStep.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer Shadow Bind for one round. Additionally, you can place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadow Step can be cast only once per activation. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.).

befuddle.name: Befuddle
befuddle.description: On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target  enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

chasten.name: Chasten
chasten.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target model/unit damaged by this attack expire.

rothsMercy.name: Roth’s Mercy
rothsMercy.description: When an enemy attack disables a living model in the target friendly Faction unit, you can choose a non-disabled living model in the unit to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Roth’s Mercy, the disabled model removes 1 damage point.

soulfire.name: Soulfire
soulfire.description: When a living, non-soulless enemy model is boxed by Soulfire, the spellcaster gains 1 focus, fury, or essence point and the boxed model is removed from play. If the spellcaster does not have a special rule that allows it to gain focus, fury, or essence points, it cannot gain a focus, fury, or essence point as a result of Soulfire.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.description: Place models in Caine’s battlegroup currently in his control range  anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Flicker can be cast only once per activation.

movingShadows.name: Moving Shadows
movingShadows.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

forceField.name: Force Field
forceField.description: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

sidekick.name: Sidekick
sidekick.description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam. While B2B with target model, the spellcaster gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam.

fireForEffect.name: Fire For Effect
fireForEffect.description: Boost the attack and damage rolls of target friendly Faction model’s first ranged attack each activation.

lockTheTarget.name: Lock the Target
lockTheTarget.description: A model damaged by Lock the Target cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

pinCushion.name: Pin Cushion
pinCushion.description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

refuge.name: Refuge
refuge.description: At the end of an activation in which target friendly Faction model hit an enemy model with an attack, the affected model can make a full advance.

arcaneShield.name: Arcane Shield
arcaneShield.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 ARM.

scramble.name: Scramble
scramble.description: Target warjack suffers Disruption for one round.

hallowedAvenger.name: Hallowed Avenger
hallowedAvenger.description: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains Righteous Vengeance. (If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of a model with Righteous Vengeance during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase the model with Righteous Vengeance can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

highGround.name: High Ground
highGround.description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid. While completely within the template, models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks and their ranged weapons gain Arcing Fire. (When attacking with a weapon with Arcing Fire, a model can ignore intervening models.)

arcaneBlast.name: Arcane Blast
arcaneBlast.description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

electricalBlast.name: Electrical Blast
electricalBlast.description: Electrical Blast causes electrical damage. Warjacks damaged by Electrical Blast suffer Disruption.

windBurst.name: Wind Burst
windBurst.description: After resolving this attack, cloud templates in the spellcaster’s control range expire.

thunderStrike.name: Thunder Strike
thunderStrike.description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by Thunder Strike is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

velocity.name: Velocity
velocity.description: The spellcaster can spend up to 3 focus points to immediately advance up to 2" for each focus point spent. Velocity can be cast only once per activation.

explosivo.name: Explosivo
explosivo.description: Target friendly Faction model’s ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. If the affected model directly hits and boxes an enemy model with an attack from a ranged weapon, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 8 magical blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

temporalDistortion.name: Temporal Distortion
temporalDistortion.description: This model gains +2 DEF. While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and enemy models suffer –2 DEF. Temporal Distortion lasts for one round.

timeBomb.name: Time Bomb
timeBomb.description: A model directly hit by Time Bomb suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

occultWhispers.name: Occult Whispers
occultWhispers.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their Arcane Attack rolls. Occult Whispers lasts for one turn.

castigate.name: Castigate
castigate.description: Enemy models cannot be used to channel spells or be forced to cast an animus while in the spellcaster’s control range. Castigate lasts for one round.

repulsion.name: Repulsion
repulsion.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 3" directly away from it in the order you choose.

draconicAura.name: Draconic Aura
draconicAura.description: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while within 10" of the spellcaster, add +2 to the roll. Fire continuous effects affecting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster cannot expire. Draconic Aura lasts for one round.

boilingBlood.name: Boiling Blood
boilingBlood.description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Fire. Additionally, when the spellcaster suffers damage as a result of an enemy melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers an unboostable POW 14 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Boiling Blood lasts for one round.

attractor.name: Attractor
attractor.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 2" directly toward it in the order you choose.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.description: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Slipstream expires. A model can be placed as a result of Slipstream only once per turn. Slipstream lasts for one turn.

massacre.name: Massacre
massacre.description: The spellcaster gains Overtake. Massacre lasts for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

mutagenesis.name: Mutagenesis
mutagenesis.description: Target enemy model boxed by Mutagenesis is removed from play. When Mutagenesis boxes an enemy model and the spellcaster was the spell’s point of origin, the spellcaster can replace the boxed model when it is removed from play.
