The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after replacing another model as a result of Mutagenesis. Mutagenesis can be cast only once per activation.

dragonsBlood.name: Dragon’s Blood
dragonsBlood.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. When an affected model is disabled by a melee attack, the attacker suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

scuttler.name: Scuttler
scuttler.description: The spellcaster gains Dig In. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

acidicTouch.name: Acidic Touch
acidicTouch.description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Corrosion and its melee weapons gain the Continuous Effect: Corrosion. Acidic Touch lasts for one round.

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.description: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Bushwhack. Lurker lasts for one turn. (During its activation, a model with Bushwhack can make its Combat Action before its Normal Movement. If it does, it must make a full advance as its Normal Movement that activation.)

silenceOfDeath.name: Silence of Death
silenceOfDeath.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Take Down. Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

spiritBlade.name: Spirit Blade
spiritBlade.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly Faction model/unit expire.

banishingWard.name: Banishing Ward
banishingWard.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly model/unit expire. Affected models cannot be targeted by enemy spells or animi.

hollow.name: Hollow
hollow.description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. Once per turn, when an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model. A model replaced by Hollow is destroyed.

hostOfShadows.name: Host of Shadows
hostOfShadows.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Ghostly. Host of Shadows lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

dissectedEssence.name: Dissected Essence
dissectedEssence.description: Target enemy model hit gains Inconsequential this turn. During your next turn, it suffers –2 ARM. (An Inconsequential model cannot score or contest scenario elements.)

rimeIce.name: Rime Ice
rimeIce.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, models in its battlegroup gain +2 ARM.

crimsonBallet.name: Crimson Ballet
crimsonBallet.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

subdue.name: Subdue
subdue.description: Remove up to 3 fury points in total from warbeasts in the spellcaster's battlegroup. Subdue can be cast only once per activation.

frostedEarth.name: Frosted Earth
frostedEarth.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down or made stationary.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.description: Target other friendly Faction warbeast that has already activated this turn immediately activates again and frenzies. After resolving the activation, it gains a number of fury points equal to its FURY. A warbeast can only be affected by Provoke once per turn.

echolocation.name: Echolocation
echolocation.description: While within 6" of this model, friendly Faction models always have line of sight to enemy models that this model has line of sight to.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.description: The spellcaster gains Bloodthirst. (When the spellcaster charges a living or undead model, it gains +2 SPD.)

feint.name: Feint
feint.description: The spellcaster gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

sacrosanct.name: Sacrosanct
sacrosanct.description: When an enemy non-Leader warrior model destroys one or more friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range with a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model becomes knocked down.

cleansingFire.name: Cleansing Fire
cleansingFire.description: Cleansing Fire causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

ashesToAshes.name: Ashes to Ashes
ashesToAshes.description: If target model is directly hit, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of it suffer a POW 10 fire damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Ashes to Ashes simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.

deathSentence.name: Death Sentence
deathSentence.description: When a friendly Faction model misses target enemy model/unit with an attack, it can reroll the attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Death Sentence.

defenderSWard.name: Defender's Ward
defenderSWard.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and ARM.

immolation.name: Immolation
immolation.description: Immolation causes fire damage. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect.

inviolableResolve__be5f2cf4.name: Inviolable Resolve
inviolableResolve__be5f2cf4.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

theFleshIsWeak.name: The Flesh Is Weak
theFleshIsWeak.description: Living and undead models damaged by The Flesh Is Weak cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

earthsSanctuary.name: Earth’s Sanctuary
earthsSanctuary.description: Target friendly Faction model becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

arcaneCharge.name: Arcane Charge
arcaneCharge.description: On a direct hit, models hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.

eliminator.name: Eliminator
eliminator.description: Immediately after this attack is resolved, the spellcaster can advance up to 2" for each enemy model destroyed by the attack.

heightenedReflexes.name: Heightened Reflexes
heightenedReflexes.description: Target friendly model can not be knocked down or made stationary for one round.

arcaneSight.name: Arcane Sight
arcaneSight.description: This model gains True Sight. (This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth)

rhythmOfWar.name: Rhythm of War
rhythmOfWar.description: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup that are in its control range can advance up to 3" after all friendly models have ended their activations on your turn.

lightningPulse.name: Lightning Pulse
lightningPulse.description: A model hit by Lightning Pulse suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Lightning Pulse damage rolls are simultaneous with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

timeLock.name: Time Lock
timeLock.description: Enemy models activating within 6" of the spellcaster suffer –2 SPD that activation. Time Lock lasts for one round.

abuse.name: Abuse
abuse.description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn but suffers d3 damage points.

discordance.name: Discordance
discordance.description: Models in this model’s battlegroup gain Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

awakenedSpirit.name: Awakened Spirit
awakenedSpirit.description: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can cast its animus once during its activation without being forced. A warbeast that casts its animus as a result of Awakened Spirit cannot also be forced to cast its animus that activation.

enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
enfeeble.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 to attack and damage rolls.

wallOfFire.name: Wall of Fire
wallOfFire.description: Place the wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Models within the wall template gain concealment.

deathToDust.name: Death to Dust
deathToDust.description: A model boxed by this attack is removed from play.

reconstruct.name: Reconstruct
reconstruct.description: When target large-based or smaller Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each system or aspect, then Reconstruct expires.

seeInTheDark.name: See in the Dark
seeInTheDark.description: The spellcaster can ignore cloud effects when determining LOS. Additionally, the spellcaster can ignore Stealth. See in the Dark lasts for one turn.

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

callOfTheGrave.name: Call of the Grave
callOfTheGrave.description: Models damaged by Call of the Grave suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

forceWall.name: Force Wall
forceWall.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

heartOfIce.name: Heart of Ice
heartOfIce.description: Target friendly Faction non-construct model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Cold. When an affected model is destroyed or removed from play by a melee attack made by an enemy warrior model, at the end of its activation the attacking model becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

snowsquall.name: Snowsquall
snowsquall.description: Enemy models activating in this model’s control range lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder for one turn.

snowWreathed.name: Snow-Wreathed
snowWreathed.description: The spellcaster has concealment. Snow-Wreathed lasts for one round.

forceBlast.name: Force Blast
forceBlast.description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Enemy models currently within 2" of the target model are pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose.

kissOfLyliss.name: Kiss of Lyliss
kissOfLyliss.description: When a friendly Faction model makes a damage roll against a model/unit hit by Kiss of Lyliss, add +2 to the roll.

tether.name: Tether
tether.description: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

lockedHorns.name: Locked Horns
lockedHorns.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Locked Horns lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

expendableCreation.name: Expendable Creation
expendableCreation.description: Target non-huge based horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending essence. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected horror suffers D3 damage points.

ritesOfTorment.name: Rites of Torment
ritesOfTorment.description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3". A horror can advance only once per turn as a result of Rites of Torment.

lastStand.name: Last Stand
lastStand.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on its melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model makes a melee attack, it is destroyed at the end of the turn.

freezingMist.name: Freezing Mist
freezingMist.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 to attack rolls.

watcher__666f8040.name: Watcher
watcher__666f8040.description: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

freezingGrip.name: Freezing Grip
freezingGrip.description: Target model/unit without Resistance: Cold becomes stationary for one round.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.description: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.

impendingDoom.name: Impending Doom
impendingDoom.description: Enemy models within 5" of the spellcaster are pushed 5" directly toward it in the order you choose.

hoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost
hoarfrost.description: Hoarfrost causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

avatarOfSlaughter.name: Avatar of Slaughter
avatarOfSlaughter.description: Target the Old Witch or Scrapjack. The affected model gains +2 MAT, +2 to its melee damage rolls, Berserk, and Overtake. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

murderOfCrows.name: Murder of Crows
murderOfCrows.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. An enemy model that enters or ends its activation in the AOE suffers an unboostable POW 8 damage roll.

unseenPath.name: Unseen Path
unseenPath.description: Unseen Path can be cast only while Scrapjack is in the Old Witch’s control range. Immediately place the Old Witch completely within 2" of Scrapjack or place Scrapjack completely within 2" of the Old Witch. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Unseen Path.

martialParagon.name: Martial Paragon
martialParagon.description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack rolls and Unstoppable.

bloodOfKings.name: Blood of Kings
bloodOfKings.description: The spellcaster gains +3 SPD, MAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, the spellcaster gains +3 to its melee attack damage rolls. Blood of Kings lasts for one round.

descendingGloom.name: Descending Gloom
descendingGloom.description: Target model hit suffers Blind. Centre a cloud effect template on the model hit. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer Blind. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

eyeOfDhunia.name: Eye of Dhunia
eyeOfDhunia.description: While attacking target model/unit, friendly Faction models gain Eyeless Sight and their weapons gain Magical and Blessed.

runeMark.name: Rune Mark
runeMark.description: Choose a friendly Trapdoor marker in range. Friendly Faction models always have line of sight to enemy models within 2" of the chosen marker. Friendly Faction models gain boosted ranged attack rolls while attacking enemy models within 2" of the marker. The marker cannot be moved or placed from its current location this turn. At the end of the turn, remove the marker from the table.

resolute.name: Resolute
resolute.description: Target friendly Faction model cannot be knocked down or moved by push or slam.

moraleBoost.name: Morale Boost
moraleBoost.description: When an enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster's control range, the spellcaster can gain one fury point. The spellcaster's fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Morale Boost.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.description: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Adaptive. (While a model with Adaptive is completely within a terrain feature that provides concealment or cover, it gains +1 DEF.)

fogWall.name: Fog Wall
fogWall.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly models gain concealment.

rageFuel.name: Rage Fuel
rageFuel.description: The spellcaster gains Primal Rage. Rage Fuel lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when a model with Primal Rage suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.)

playingGod.name: Playing God
playingGod.description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast is affected by Spontaneous Mutation effects while they affect Absylonia. Additionally, once per turn Absylonia can transfer damage to the affected warbeast without spending fury.

despoiler.name: Despoiler
despoiler.description: Center a cloud effect template on the spellcaster. The template remains centered on the spellcaster for one round. If the spellcaster is destroyed or removed from play, remove the template from play. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer 1 point of corrosion damage.

bloodThorn.name: Blood Thorn
bloodThorn.description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect: Corrosion.

invocationOfBlood.name: Invocation of Blood
invocationOfBlood.description: If Bethayne is flesh melded with Belphagor when this spell is cast, Belphagor gains +2 SPD, DEF, and ARM  and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round. Otherwise, Bethayne immediately makes a full advance toward Belphagor. Invocation of Blood can be cast only once per activation.

hornetsNest.name: Hornet’s Nest
hornetsNest.description: When target friendly Faction lesser warbeast destroys an enemy model with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 1" and make an additional melee attack. Hornet’s Nest lasts for one turn.

howlingFlames.name: Howling Flames
howlingFlames.description: Howling Flames causes fire damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire continuous effect.

eruptionOfSpines.name: Eruption of Spines
eruptionOfSpines.description: If target model is hit, the d3 nearest models within 5" of it suffer a POW 10 damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Eruption of Spines damage rolls are simultaneous.

fullSteam.name: Full Steam
fullSteam.description: Target friendly Faction warbeast can charge without being forced. When the affected model charges a construct model, it gains +2 SPD.

respawn.name: Respawn
respawn.description: When target large-based or smaller warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each aspect, then Respawn expires.

markedForDeath.name: Marked for Death
markedForDeath.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF, loses Incorporeal and Stealth and cannot gain Incorporeal or Stealth while affected by Marked for Death.

psychicVampire.name: Psychic Vampire
psychicVampire.description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model's control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers 1 damage point and this model can remove 1 damage point. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

twistedForm.name: Twisted Form
twistedForm.description: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY, cannot have damage removed from it, and cannot have damage transferred to it. Twisted Form lasts for one round. Twisted Form can be cast only once per activation.

icyGrip.name: Icy Grip
icyGrip.description: Target model hit without Resistance: Cold suffers –2 SPD for one round.

frostField.name: Frost Field
frostField.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Chiller. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

incite.name: Incite
incite.description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to attack and damage rolls against enemy models while the enemy models are within 10" of the spellcaster. Incite lasts for one turn.

blindingLight.name: Blinding Light
blindingLight.description: A model/unit hit cannot make ranged or arcane attacks and suffers –2 DEF.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.description: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Foresight.

easyRider.name: Easy Rider
easyRider.description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Pathfinder. Easy Rider lasts for one turn.

blowTheManDown.name: Blow the Man Down
blowTheManDown.description: A model hit by Blow the Man Down becomes knocked down. On a critical hit, instead of suffering a normal damage roll a non-incorporeal model hit is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

coupDeMain.name: Coup de Main
coupDeMain.description: The spellcaster and friendly Privateer models activating in its control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Affected warjacks can charge without spending a focus point. Coup de Main lasts for one turn.

putridMiasma.name: Putrid Miasma
putridMiasma.description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models gain Magic Resistance. (When a model with Magic Resistance is targeted by an arcane attack roll, the attacking model rolls 1 additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll.) Putrid Miasma lasts for one round.

soulShift.name: Soul Shift
soulShift.description: Remove a friendly Faction warrior model within 4" of the spellcaster from play and replace it with a friendly Faction cohort model within 4" of the spellcaster. The cohort model must forfeit its Normal Movement and cannot attack after being placed by Soul Shift this turn. Soul Shift can only be cast once per turn.

carrionFeast.name: Carrion Feast
carrionFeast.description: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

gravetouched.name: Gravetouched
gravetouched.description: While within 2" of target friendly Faction model, enemy models suffer –2 DEF.

deathSDominion.name: Death's Dominion
deathSDominion.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Undead models gain Resistance: Blast and Rise. (If a model with RIse is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.)

crimsonVeil.name: Crimson Veil
crimsonVeil.description: Target friendly Faction model's melee weapons gain Blood Shadow. (If an attack with a weapon with Blood Shadow boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.)

sacrilegiousFervor.name: Sacrilegious Fervor
sacrilegiousFervor.description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM. When an affected model is destroyed by an enemy attack a friendly Leader model can gain 1 focus, fury, or essence point.

wingedNuisance.name: Winged Nuisance
wingedNuisance.description: Place target enemy non-Leader model hit completely within 2" of its current location. A model can only be affected by Winged Nuisance once per turn.

thistle.name: Thistle
thistle.description: If the target model is within 2" of forest terrain, attack and damage rolls are boosted when resolving this spell.

lashingTendrils.name: Lashing Tendrils
lashingTendrils.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit's melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Chain Weapon.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

hexHammer.name: Hex Hammer
hexHammer.description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model’s control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect. Hex Hammer lasts for one round.

arcaneWard.name: Arcane Ward
arcaneWard.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

creatorsWrath.name: Creator’s Wrath
creatorsWrath.description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gains Blessed.

brandOfHeresy.name: Brand of Heresy
brandOfHeresy.description: Cohort models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain boosted attack and damage rolls against target model/unit.

handOfTheCreator.name: Hand of the Creator
handOfTheCreator.description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly Faction model currently in the spellcaster’s control range. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

guidedHand.name: Guided Hand
guidedHand.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on each model’s next melee attack roll this turn.

penitence.name: Penitence
penitence.description: Target friendly Faction model/unit. When one or more affected models are damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacker suffers 1 point of fire damage unless it has Immunity: Fire.

wellOfSecrets.name: Well of Secrets
wellOfSecrets.description: Enemy upkeep spells on the spellcaster immediately expire. Additionally, the spellcaster gains Sacred Ward for one round. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

phantomHunter.name: Phantom Hunter
phantomHunter.description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup ignores LOS when making charges and attacks. That model ignores concealment, cover, and Stealth when resolving attacks. Phantom Hunter lasts for one turn.

raveningHunger.name: Ravening Hunger
raveningHunger.description: The spellcaster gains Snacking. (When a model with snacking boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.)

vortexOfDestruction.name: Vortex of Destruction
vortexOfDestruction.description: Damage rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s melee range are automatically boosted.

nightsReflection.name: Night’s Reflection
nightsReflection.description: Target model/unit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

blackestNight__1f5ef52a.name: Blackest Night
blackestNight__1f5ef52a.description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –1 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

roilingDarkness.name: Roiling Darkness
roilingDarkness.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –1 to melee attack and damage rolls. Enemy models suffer –1 to ranged attack and damage rolls against the spellcaster. This effect is cumulative, up to a maximum of 3.

smotheringGloom.name: Smothering Gloom
smotheringGloom.description: Enemy models currently within 3" of the spellcaster suffer Blind. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

umbralPulse.name: Umbral Pulse
umbralPulse.description: Enemy models currently within 3" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose.

arcaneDampening.name: Arcane Dampening
arcaneDampening.description: The spellcaster gains Magic Static. Arcane Dampening lasts for one round. (Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of a model with Arcane Dampening model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.)

theLash.name: The Lash
theLash.description: When The Lash damages an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of The Lash.

bloodMark.name: Blood Mark
bloodMark.description: Target enemy model suffers –2 ARM. The spellcaster can transfer damage from an enemy attack to the affected model one time, then Blood Mark expires.

fleshHooks.name: Flesh Hooks
fleshHooks.description: Target living or undead model damaged by Flesh Hooks cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

shadowPlay.name: Shadow Play
shadowPlay.description: Target friendly Faction model gains Incorporeal this turn. During your Control Phase, the affected model gains Incorporeal for one turn.

soulSlave.name: Soul Slave
soulSlave.description: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup automatically passes threshold checks. The spellcaster can channel spells through that warbeast.

handOfMorrow.name: Hand of Morrow
handOfMorrow.description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical.

coldFront.name: Cold Front
coldFront.description: The spellcaster gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

frozenGround.name: Frozen Ground
frozenGround.description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 3" of the spellcaster, the enemy model becomes knocked down. Frozen Ground lasts for one round

mantrap.name: Mantrap
mantrap.description: On a direct hit, warrior models hit become knocked down.

cursedFate.name: Cursed Fate
cursedFate.description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point. Cursed Fate lasts for one turn.

spiritualConduit.name: Spiritual Conduit
spiritualConduit.description: This model’s controller can channel spells through it. Spiritual Conduit lasts for one turn.

moshPit.name: Mosh Pit
moshPit.description: Knocked down friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range immediately stand up. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models' melee weapons gain Knockdown. Mosh Pit lasts for one turn. (When a model is hit with an attack by a weapon with Knockdown, it becomes knocked down.)

unminding.name: Unminding
unminding.description: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY and THR and loses its animus. The spellcaster can cast an affected warbeast’s animus.

rampager.name: Rampager
rampager.description: Take control of target enemy warbeast. You can make one full advance with the warbeast and can then make one basic attack, then Rampager expires. While the warbeast is affected by Rampager, it cannot be forced and you cannot use its animus. Rampager can be cast only once per activation. A warbeast can be affected by Rampager only once per turn.

lightningFists.name: Lightning Fists
lightningFists.description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Electricity and its melee weapons gain Electro Leap. Lightning Fists lasts for one round. (When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with a weapon with Electro Leap, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that caused the leap.)

vortexOfTheDeep.name: Vortex of the Deep
vortexOfTheDeep.description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within 10" of the spellcaster. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

evenGround.name: Even Ground
evenGround.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down. Even Ground lasts for one round.

puissance.name: Puissance
puissance.description: Target friendly model/unit gains +2 to its melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gain Beat Back. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it".)

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.description: On a direct hit, the model hit and other models within 2" of it become knocked down.

invocationsOfWrath.name: Invocations of Wrath
invocationsOfWrath.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Invocations of Wrath lasts for one turn.

darkUnraveling.name: Dark Unraveling
darkUnraveling.description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Dark Unraveling lasts for one turn.
